tokenIntro.title: What is <gradient>NX036</gradient>?
tokenIntro.description: A token with a fixed supply that allows no more to be generated. Every time someone transfers, buys tokens or uses the e-commerce, a portion disappears forever, reducing the tokens in circulation.

burn.title: Automatic Burn
burn.desc: Each transfer automatically burns 1%. The supply decreases with every movement.

ecommerce.title: NX036 E-Commerce
ecommerce.desc: Buy real products and earn loyalty points. Each purchase burns tokens from the pool.

staking.title: Daily Staking
staking.desc: Stake your tokens and receive daily rewards for 90 days proportional to your stake.

burnSimulator.title: A token that <gradient>burns</gradient>
burnSimulator.description: Every time you send NX036 to another person, a percentage is permanently destroyed. It goes to a locked wallet where it cannot be recovered — it disappears from the total supply. You can simulate it:
burnSimulator.supplyImpact: With this transfer, the total supply was reduced by {{count}} tokens — forever. No one can recover them.
burnSimulator.note: The current rate is 1% but the owner can adjust it between 1% and 10%. The global cap is 500 billion burned tokens (50% of supply). After that, transfers continue without burning and the collected funds are used to distribute tokens to holders.

dex.title: Smart <gradient>buying & selling</gradient>
dex.description: When you buy or sell NX036 on a DEX like PancakeSwap, fixed and immutable fees apply that fund the project's development. Tokens are burned in these operations. See exactly where each token goes:
dex.resultNote: Of {{amount}} tokens, {{devFee}} are retained for development{{promoNote}}. Tokens are burned in DEX operations. These fees are fixed and immutable in the contract.

ecommerce.title: Shop at <gradient>NX036 E-Commerce</gradient>
ecommerce.description: Our e-commerce platform integrates the token directly. Each purchase you make immediately burns tokens from the pool. The customer receives redeemable loyalty points. The higher the tier, the more tokens will be burned (This is an example to illustrate).
ecommerce.selectProduct: Select a product to see what happens with the tokens

howSteps.1: Buy a product in the NX036 store with your usual payment method.
howSteps.2: The backend registers your purchase in the smart contract with the USD amount.
howSteps.3: The contract calculates your tokens based on your tier and burns them immediately from the pool.
howSteps.4: You receive equivalent loyalty points. The total supply of NX036 was reduced.

staking.title: Earn while you <gradient>hold</gradient>
staking.description: Stake your NX036 and receive daily rewards for 90 days. 50 billion tokens are distributed proportionally among all stakers. You need to keep your stake for at least 24 hours to start earning.
staking.hour0: Hour 0: You deposit your tokens. They enter as "pending" — you are not yet earning rewards.
staking.hour24: Hour 24: Your stake activates. You start receiving your proportional share in each distribution.
staking.day90: Day 90: The staking program ends. You can withdraw your tokens + all rewards.

vesting.title: The team <gradient>cannot run</gradient>
vesting.description: The 9% of the supply allocated to the team is locked by smart contract for 3 to 5 years. There is no way to access it before. Anyone can verify it on-chain.
vesting.trustDesc: The 3 vesting grants (30B each) are registered in the NX036Vesting contract. Anyone can call vestedAmount() and releasableAmount() to confirm the tokens are locked.

burnCap.title: What happens when we reach <gradient>50%</gradient>?
burnCap.description: NX036 has a 50% burn cap of the supply (500 billion). When reached, burning stops but fees continue. Those funds are used to buy back tokens on the market and redistribute them, 90% to holders and 10% to the platform.
